purpose: 原始口径核查和网站实际应用树的历史训练期回测

backtest.sample: fraud original train indices only: label years 2007-2019
backtest.split: TimeSeriesSplit over unique years, same boundaries as v1
backtest.features: same 36 non-ID non-label columns as v1 application tree
backtest.preprocessing: replace inf with NaN, training-fold medians only, no clipping or scaling, same as v1 application
backtest.all_missing_training_columns: user approved: disable within that fold only; retain when training observations exist; never borrow future medians
backtest.ties: report strict higher-score set, boundary tie size, exact-quota min/max and expected uniform random tie sampling; also report all-boundary-ties inclusion
backtest.uncertainty: 500 company-block bootstrap resamples of fixed out-of-fold predictions, seed 42; no model refitting
backtest.interpretation: historical training-period development backtest; not a fresh untouched final test

raw_finance_spotcheck.candidate_financial_years: target year and target year minus one; application compare financial years 2024 and 2025
raw_finance_spotcheck.duplicate_policy: preserve all candidates, report ambiguities, do not silently choose corrected records

bankruptcy_source_check.purpose: provenance equality check only; no replacement of course input
